purpose: Four rows of T1-official-pop-500, end to end, before the registered 508-call flight: prove the -np 2 serving geometry, the released system message, the user-turn text part after the audio, sealing and the four registered Audio2Tool scorers on real sealed rows. The rows are the roster's lexicographically first, shortest, median-length and LONGEST samples, and the longest is deliberately tier1_direct:003943 -- the released tier-1 population's 654.6325 s wav, the only request in this flight with no precedent in this repository's history. The flight must not discover at row 400 that the pinned runtime cannot encode it. No smoke number is a task measurement.

T1-official-pop-500.selection: deterministic and stated before the rows were chosen: the roster's lexicographically first sample, its shortest, its median-length and its longest

execution_plan_basis.calls: 4 rows x 1 contact = 4 for a clean pass. The plan registers 12 because attempt budget is enforced RUN-CUMULATIVELY: core.model.adapter.FrozenCoreAdapter re-reads every prior attempt's durable actuals for this run id on every request. 12 covers a clean pass plus up to two recoveries; the exposure row's own ceiling is 20.
execution_plan_basis.speech_audio_seconds: 659.583333 s per pass, 1,978.75 s across three passes, rounded up to 2,000. Almost all of it is the single 654.6325 s row the smoke exists to test; the exposure row's ceiling is 2,050.

evaluation.what_is_read: transport legality, the rendered prompt shape and its system-message hash (which must be the in-code-default variant, sha256 be7f31a2e8c7e6dd..., 16,143 chars), whether the 654.6325 s row encodes and returns at all, parse rate and throughput
evaluation.what_is_not_read: no smoke metric is a task measurement and none enters the verdict. The calibration's own smoke is the standing precedent: on four rows it saw zero native tool calls and concluded the model was declining the tools interface, which 400 rows corrected to 87 %.

decision.gate: the cell must complete 4 of 4 contacts, seal a verifiable manifest and score without error before the registered 508-call flight is launched
decision.long_row_contingency: If tier1_direct:003943 cannot be served by the pinned runtime (encode failure, timeout, or a request that does not fit its slot), the flight is NOT launched with a silent 499; the preregistration's contingency is applied, the exclusion is registered with its cause, and the tier-1 number is reported on the surviving n with the exclusion named in the verdict.

companion_run.why_separate: contracts.gate_exposure requires exactly one pre-registered exposure row per run id whose split identity hash equals the plan's, so a run id cannot span two populations. The two smoke cells therefore run under two run ids, each with its own plan and its own ledger row.
